items.headline: Anthropic shares fall 13% as AI-trade concerns intensify
items.summary: Anthropic shares declined about 13% in their first full trading day as investors reassessed the strength and valuation of the AI trade after the company's IPO.

items.headline: S&P 500 drops 3.7% as AI-stock sell-off accelerates
items.summary: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Nasdaq moved negative for the year as selling pressure intensified across AI-linked equities, including Nvidia, amid concerns about the scale and durability of the AI build-out.

items.headline: AI-linked equities slide as funding and valuation risks draw scrutiny
items.summary: Market coverage highlighted broad weakness in AI infrastructure and semiconductor names as investors questioned capital intensity, valuation support and the sustainability of the AI investment cycle.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO fails to revive broader AI-market enthusiasm
items.summary: A market review reported that Anthropic's debut and Nvidia's earnings did not restore confidence in the wider AI trade, with risk aversion spreading across related assets.

items.headline: Intuit cuts fiscal-year outlook as AI search disrupts Credit Karma
items.summary: Intuit reported quarterly results but reduced parts of its fiscal-year outlook, with coverage citing higher-for-longer rates and search shifting toward AI chatbots as pressures on Credit Karma.
